name: Kafka Studio
description: Operate Apache Kafka from one workspace: inspect topics and partitions, produce and consume messages, filter and decode payloads, monitor consumer lag, manage offsets and ACLs, stream records, and export results.

versions.releaseNotes: 首个商店版本（Kafka Studio）：在一个 DBX 工作台中管理 Apache Kafka——topic/分区/消费组巡检、消息生产与消费（本地聚合 digest、cursor 翻页与流式导出）、消费组 lag 监控与受控 offset 重置、topic/ACL 运维，支持 PLAINTEXT/TLS/SASL（PLAIN/SCRAM）、Kerberos、OAUTHBEARER 与 Confluent/AWS Glue Schema Registry；工作台界面提供 7 种语言（en/zh-CN/zh-TW/es/it/ja/pt-BR）；写操作受只读、allowDelete 与两阶段确认保护，并提供 11 个 MCP 工具供 AI 自动化调用。

首个商店版本（Kafka Studio）：在一个 DBX 工作台中管理 Apache Kafka——topic/分区/消费组巡检、消息生产与消费（本地聚合 digest、cursor 翻页与流式导出）、消费组 lag 监控与受控 offset 重置、topic/ACL 运维，支持 PLAINTEXT/TLS/SASL（PLAIN/SCRAM）、Kerberos、OAUTHBEARER 与 Confluent/AWS Glue Schema Registry；工作台界面提供 7 种语言（en/zh-CN/zh-TW/es/it/ja/pt-BR）；写操作受只读、allowDelete 与两阶段确认保护，并提供 11 个 MCP 工具供 AI 自动化调用。

修复 DBX 隧道/代理下的 Kafka 连接：插件改为拨宿主下发的最终端点 runtime.host:port，并在宿主下发 runtime.proxy 时让所有 broker（含 advertised.listeners 发现的）共用同一个 SOCKS5 dialer，admin/生产/一次性消费/流式消费一致生效；代理路径补齐 TLS 握手与按 broker 的 SNI。消费组 offset 重置修复 Kafka 4.x 误报成功的问题（OffsetCommit v10 起以 topic id 标识主题，旧提交被 broker 以 UNKNOWN_TOPIC_ID 拒绝），任一分区被拒即返回错误。Fixes Kafka connections behind DBX transport/proxy layers: the sidecar now dials the host-provided runtime endpoint and, when the host publishes runtime.proxy, routes every broker (including brokers discovered via advertised.listeners) through one SOCKS5 dialer shared by admin, produce, one-shot consume and stream clients, with the TLS handshake and per-broker SNI applied after the proxy CONNECT. Consumer-group offset reset now commits by topic id for Kafka 4.x (OffsetCommit v10+) instead of being rejected as UNKNOWN_TOPIC_ID and misreported as success.

修复深色主题下 Topic 侧栏不可读的问题：图标色随 color-scheme 自动翻转，核心颜色令牌改为实时跟随宿主主题（不再被内联快照冻结），并提升树行/星标对比度。消息查询新增「最近 N 条」Offset 策略并设为默认：原「最新」策略从日志末端只等待新消息，对没有持续流量的 topic 总是「已扫描 0 · 命中 0」，现在默认即可读到每个分区最新的历史记录。Fixed topics sidebar legibility in dark theme: icon hues follow color-scheme, core color tokens now track the host theme live instead of being frozen by an inline snapshot, and tree row/star contrast was raised. Messages query adds a recent-N offset strategy and defaults to it: the previous latest default only waited for new records and always scanned zero on idle topics; the new default surfaces the newest existing records per partition.

修复工作台状态在真机上不持久化的问题：DBX 沙箱 iframe 的 opaque origin 下 localStorage 直接抛错，原持久化静默失效；现在统一经 pluginStorage 适配器接入宿主 window.dbxPlugin.storage（Host API 1.2，capabilities.storage 探测，降级链：宿主桥 → 受控 localStorage → 内存，旧键一次性搬家），消息查询表单、树宽/折叠、内部 topic 显示、收藏 topic 与时区设置刷新后均保留。同步完成依赖升级：后端 twmb/franz-go 1.22.0、golang.org/x/net 0.59.0 等，前端 vue 3.5.43、ag-grid-community 36.2.0 等，工具链基线提升至 Go 1.26。Fixed workbench state not persisting on the desktop host: localStorage throws under the sandbox iframe's opaque origin, so the previous persistence silently failed; state now goes through a pluginStorage adapter backed by the host window.dbxPlugin.storage bridge (Host API 1.2, capabilities.storage detection, with guarded localStorage and in-memory fallbacks and one-shot legacy-key migration), keeping the messages form, tree width/collapse, internal-topic visibility, favorite topics and timezone across reloads. Dependencies were upgraded in lockstep: twmb/franz-go 1.22.0 and golang.org/x/net 0.59.0 on the backend, vue 3.5.43 and ag-grid-community 36.2.0 on the frontend, with the toolchain floor raised to Go 1.26.

2026-09-26 安全审查修复批次：解压全分支 16MiB 上限（LimitReader 与 zstd max-memory）并给 valueText 补齐同规格 base64 截断，杜绝解压炸弹；修复消费池竞态（consumePoolPut 跳过 inUse 条目，并发同形状消费不再互杀）；LoadSettings 补 cursorTtlSecs/maxCursorSessions 持久化往返；regex 过滤命中预编译缓存；stream/start 预校验 decode/decompression 参数。Schema Registry 客户端接入连接 TLS 配置，skip-verify 连接在审计中留痕并修订三值契约注释；消费组删除新增输入组名确认（ensureGroupDeleteConfirm，前端七语），CSS 令牌语义化。打包链路改为源码现构建前端（ui/index.html 脱库），build.sh 支持 DBX_PREBUILT_UI=1 复用 CI 预置产物。Security review fixes: 16MiB cap on all decompress branches (LimitReader + zstd max-memory) with matching base64 truncation for valueText to defuse decompression bombs; consume-pool race fix (consumePoolPut skips inUse entries so concurrent same-shape consumes no longer evict each other); LoadSettings now round-trips cursorTtlSecs/maxCursorSessions; regex filter hits the precompiled cache; stream/start pre-validates decode/decompression params. The Schema Registry client now honors connection TLS settings, skip-verify connections are recorded in the audit trail, and group deletion gained a type-the-group-name confirmation (seven languages). Packaging now builds the frontend from source (ui/index.html de-vendored), and build.sh supports DBX_PREBUILT_UI=1 to reuse CI-built UI.
